ownerAssessments.assessment: A video leading a child into a rabbit hole is the causative frame of the existing extended linked-exploration metaphor. It does not require a new meaning; the revised brief allows useful or distracting exploration and the takeaway gives a distinct recipe-index context.

Not buying a tablet on a whim denies an impulsive reason; changing course on a whim and buying on a whim share the same adverbial cause. The revised brief keeps neutral valence and the new course-signup takeaway naturally tests considered action under negation.

Squeezing everyone into the same mould is the progressive/general-object frame of the existing imposed-conformity metaphor. The brief and takeaway retain the one-size-fits-all harm without making every shared rubric inherently wrong.
